verdict.rationale: A payroll SaaS with a developer API could reasonably offer scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence only lists 'OAuth' as a topic of the QuickBooks Workforce API. Nothing documents scopes, permission granularity, least-privilege credential issuance, or agent-specific credentials, so scoped credentials are unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
